Read literally, that puts G at the first value and D at the second. This pairing is the reverse of the usual carbon Raman convention, where G is the higher-wavenumber band and D the lower-wavenumber band, so the paper's assignment looks swapped; the values are given as printed. The paper also gives an ID/IG ratio of 0.91[3]. In a later passage, the paper says the D peak is >25 wavenumbers[4] red shift after combined sulfur infiltration and sodiation.
